- HARDENING_SUGGESTION 1 (not a finding; no severity/confidence stated; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2)
  File: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh
  Location: the new grant-record generation block (the `python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/files_touched_scope_guard.py" --emit-automation-grant ...` call), around line 402-404
  PROBLEM: stderr is redirected to `/dev/null` (`>/dev/null 2>&1`), so when the guard fails the operator sees only `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT phase=collect outcome=none reason=grant_error paths=0` and not the cause.
  WHY: The metadata step is now the only grant source for pipeline-authored re-issues. A regression in `build_automation_grant`, or a change in the shape of the `--origin-repo` API path, would therefore silently disable every pipeline re-issue grant. Suggested fix is to run the guard with `2> "${_github_ai_grant_record_file}.log"` and append `detail=$(head -c 200 ... | tr -cd '[:print:]' | cut -c1-200)` to the grant_error log line. Estimated lines changed: 4-6.

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION 1 (not a finding; no severity/confidence stated; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  File: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh
  Location: line 402-404 (the `timeout 300 python3 ... files_touched_scope_guard.py --emit-automation-grant ...` invocation, which ends with `>/dev/null 2>&1`), and line 410 which logs `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT phase=collect outcome=none reason=grant_error paths=0`.
